note: npm weekly downloads hardcoded as of 2026-08-05 (api.npmjs.org). Crimea verdicts verified by point-in-polygon test of Simferopol/Sevastopol against each library's shipped/CDN geometry, with Kyiv/Moscow calibration. Full evidence: data/geodata_js_census.json in the research repo.

families.label: Natural Earth default
families.sub: SOVEREIGNT=Russia for Crimea; repo dormant since June 2022

families.label: Pre-2014 NE snapshot
families.sub: frozen before the annexation — correct by inertia

depends.label: Depends on data the developer supplies

libraries.name: d3 + d3-geo
libraries.detail: No bundled geometry, but the canonical D3 choropleth recipe fetches world-atlas. d3-geo alone: 26.0M/wk.

libraries.name: topojson-client
libraries.detail: world-atlas companion decoder in every D3 map tutorial.

libraries.name: react-simple-maps
libraries.detail: Official docs point at world-atlas CDN TopoJSON.

libraries.name: world-atlas
libraries.detail: Repackaged NE. countries-110m and countries-50m both verified: Crimean cities inside Russia polygon.

libraries.name: chartjs-chart-geo
libraries.detail: Docs fetch world-atlas from unpkg. Host library chart.js: 12.8M/wk.

libraries.name: plotly.js
libraries.detail: v3.1 (2025) switched bundled maps to UN geodata — verified Ukraine. BUT cdn.plot.ly default still serves the legacy Natural Earth map — verified Russia. Migration issue #7505 open since Aug 2025. Count = plotly.js + plotly.js-dist-min.

libraries.name: echarts
libraries.detail: The de-facto standard world.json (echarts@4.9) predates 2014 — verified Ukraine. v5 unbundled maps.

libraries.name: highcharts
libraries.detail: Deliberate policy: world map contains no polygon for Crimea; paired ru-all / ru-all-disputed variants push the choice to the developer.

libraries.name: vega + vega-lite
libraries.detail: vega-datasets world-110m is a pre-2014 NE snapshot — verified Ukraine.

libraries.name: @amcharts/amcharts5
libraries.detail: worldLow verified Ukraine; no Russia-worldview variant exists.

libraries.name: datamaps
libraries.detail: Embedded world topology frozen ~2013 — verified Ukraine (calibrated). Unmaintained.

libraries.name: jsvectormap
libraries.detail: jvectormap-lineage Miller paths — Simferopol verified in UA path.

libraries.name: fusioncharts
libraries.detail: Proprietary webpack bundle; geometry not extracted — flagged, not guessed.

libraries.name: anychart
libraries.detail: CDN geodata world.json verified Ukraine (calibrated mill+affine).

libraries.name: leaflet + react-leaflet
libraries.detail: No bundled polygons. Choropleth overlays pull whatever GeoJSON the tutorial uses: datahub geo-countries (Russia) or johan (Ukraine) — a coin flip.

datasets_no_npm.name: datahub geo-countries
datasets_no_npm.detail: NE-derived GeoJSON used across Leaflet/folium tutorials — verified Russia.
